remarks: Runaway Bay offers an amazing opportunity for you to build your dream home in the most unique development in Western New York. This brand new development offers direct, drivable access via golf cart to the Lower Niagara River in Youngstown for all home owners that are part of their community. Enjoy the exclusive amenities that are highly sought after by home owners that have a love for the water. This subdivision gives you the opportunity to own a private dock licensed to your home, plus enjoy the luxuries of a beach, kayak racks, river front patio, and a boat house with restrooms and kitchen. These amenities are available to all Runaway Bay homeowners and are located just steps from the development. You can enjoy a quiet, tranquil setting while taking in the spectacular sweeping water views and peaceful sunsets overlooking Canada. All of this serenity is only minutes from the Villages of Lewiston and Youngstown, the thruway, parks, trails, restaurants, theatre, and more! This upscale, HOA governed neighborhood includes landscaping and lighting in all common areas, along with full maintenance of all the luxurious amenities.
